test_title: PYST 71: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which government body introduced the FASTag annual pass?

options.text: Directorate of National Toll and Transit
Ministry of Rural Infrastructure and Bridges

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Highways Authority of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Highways Authority of India** (**NHAI**) is the primary body responsible for the introduction and management of the **FASTag** system, which includes the provision for **annual** and **monthly passes** for frequent commuters.
 
• The **FASTag** initiative was launched to enable **Electronic Toll Collection** (**ETC**) on **National Highways**, aimed at reducing bottle-necks at toll plazas and ensuring a seamless flow of traffic.
 
• The **annual pass** facility is specifically designed for **local residents** and frequent users who reside within a **20-kilometer radius** of a specific **toll plaza**, allowing them to pay a concessional fixed rate for unlimited trips.
 
• This system operates using **Radio Frequency Identification** (**RFID**) technology, where a tag affixed to the vehicle's windshield is read by a sensor, and the toll amount is **automatically debited** from a linked **prepaid account** or **bank account**.
 
• The implementation is carried out through the **Indian Highway Management Company Limited** (**IHMCL**), an entity promoted by **NHAI**, in collaboration with over **30 member banks** and the **National Payments Corporation of India** (**NPCI**).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Establishment of NHAI**: The **National Highways Authority of India** was constituted by an **Act of Parliament**, the **NHAI Act, 1988**. It became operational in **1995** and works under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways** (**MoRTH**).
 
• **Mandatory Implementation**: The **Government of India** made **FASTag mandatory** for all **M and N category vehicles** (four-wheelers and above) from **February 15, 2021**. Vehicles entering the FASTag lane without a functional tag are liable to pay **double the toll amount** as a penalty.
 
• **One Vehicle One FASTag Initiative**: To improve the efficiency of the **Electronic Toll Collection** system, **NHAI** introduced the '**One Vehicle One FASTag**' norm to discourage the use of multiple tags for one vehicle or using one tag for multiple vehicles.
 
• **Economic and Environmental Benefits**: The adoption of **FASTag** significantly reduces **fuel consumption** by minimizing idling time at toll booths and reduces **air pollution**. It also provides **data-driven insights** for traffic management and infrastructure planning.
 
• **Recharge and Validity**: A **FASTag** is valid for a period of **5 years**. Users can recharge their accounts through various digital modes including **UPI**, **BBPS**, **Net Banking**, and **Debit/Credit cards**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Local Pass Eligibility**: The **annual pass** or **monthly pass** for local vehicles is subject to **verification of residence** (via Aadhar or Electricity bill). The **NHAI** guidelines specify that this concession is available to **non-commercial vehicles** registered in the local district.
 
• **Technological Integration**: The **FASTag** system is integrated with the **Vahan** database to verify vehicle details, which helps in preventing **toll evasion** and tracking **stolen vehicles** across the national highway network.
 
• **Global Context**: India's **FASTag** system is similar to electronic tolling systems used in other countries, such as **E-ZPass** in the **United States** and **Salik** in **Dubai**, representing a shift towards **Intelligent Transport Systems** (**ITS**).
</ul
